clauses.quote: Ten days of sick leave will be granted annually with full pay, cumulative to thirty teaching days.
When the effective date of appointment of a teacher is before the beginning of the second semester of any school year, he or she will be given credit for the full annual sick leave allowance.
When the effective date of appointment of a teacher is on or after the beginning of the second semester, the teacher will be given credit for five days’ sick leave allowance.
One additional day of annual sick leave will be added for each additional contract month served beyond the regular school year.
clauses.subject_text: One additional day of annual sick leave

clauses.quote: Verification of any disability may be required any time a teacher is absent from work.
clauses.notes: Grants management discretion to request verification

clauses.quote: If disability verification has not been required sooner, the teacher shall furnish such verification, on or before the twenty-first calendar day of disability, using the District's "Diagnosis and Functional Limitations" form.
The form must be submitted to the District Human Resources office.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is the teacher

clauses.quote: A teacher whose personal illness extends beyond his or her accumulated sick leave may be granted a leave of absence of up to one year without pay or increment.
clauses.subject_text: A teacher whose personal illness extends beyond his or her accumulated sick leave
